Dash governance system uses masternode owners as voters on budget and funding proposals. Dash governance system funds proposals from a portion of the block reward during superblocks. Dash governance system operates alongside miners, who secure the network through proof-of-work.

ZenCash (Horizen) is a privacy-focused blockchain derived from Zcash. ZenCash (Horizen) uses the Equihash proof-of-work algorithm. ZenCash (Horizen) supports sidechains as a scaling and application layer.

Stakefish provides staking infrastructure for proof-of-stake blockchain networks. Stakefish operates validator nodes on behalf of its clients.

Swell Network is a liquid staking and restaking protocol built on Ethereum. Swell Network issues liquid staking tokens that represent staked ether. Swell Network offers restaking to extend staking rewards to additional services.

Tornado Cash is a privacy protocol implemented as smart contracts on Ethereum. Tornado Cash mixes deposited crypto assets to break the link between sender and recipient addresses. Tornado Cash was sanctioned by the United States Treasury's Office of Foreign Assets Control in 2022.
